text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes—I dream about it.
About the time I lost the other day."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Normally, maybe some Umamusume would forget.
But I...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I can't forget. I just can't forget it...
To stop having that dream—"
choice_data_list: We just have to win and wipe away this frustration!

text_block_list.text: Yes. I took a proper look back at what went wrong and made the necessary adjustments.
